title: Choose the /design-system page structure
question: Re-roll 1: a fresh hand of three structures (none shown before). The world stays fixed by the Design Constitution; keep the lead, take another, steer, or re-roll again.

options.label: Three Modes
options.lineage: parallel-text editions that set one passage in three languages side by side
options.thesis: Every component is shown once in MARKET, LEDGER and FLOW side by side, so the recipe, not a new component, carries the difference.
options.viewport: Layer index on the left; ListBlock entry with the same three products as MARKET cards, LEDGER rows and FLOW pick lines, recipe values captioned under each.
options.risk: Three columns crowd tablet widths; below 1100px the modes become tabs over one specimen.

raised.raise: Thread states are drawn by stroke pattern (solid confirmed, dashed awaiting, gapped stale), never by hue alone.
A 4px cell grid can be toggled over any specimen as a real state, so spacing is checkable against the tokens.

options.label: Inventory Ledger
options.thesis: The page opens on the whole component inventory as one filterable ledger; each row expands in place to its live specimen.
options.viewport: Filter chips for class and mode over a 118-row ledger; the StockAvailabilityIndicator row is expanded to show its five states.
options.risk: Scanning rows suits lookup more than learning; first-time readers need a short orientation above the ledger.

options.label: Field Guide
options.lineage: naturalist field guides with plates and look-alikes
options.thesis: Each component is an entry you identify by its job, with where it is found, its look-alikes and plates of every variant.
options.viewport: A-Z thumb index down the left edge; ActionMenu entry with 'Identify by', 'Found in' and its look-alikes ActionBar and BulkActions, then variant plates.
options.risk: Alphabetical order hides the build layers; the layer of each entry must stay visible on its title.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Numbered lanes on black glass, each tied to its default by a link line.
options.viewport: A drifting lane grid under a fixed legend strip.
options.risk: Black glass contradicts warm neutral surfaces; drifting lanes are decorative motion.
options.case: Loses on audience: a design reference is not a patch bay.
options.kept: State drawn by stroke pattern, not colour.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: Monumental grid letterforms over a small grotesk.
options.risk: Monumental display type competes with specimens.
options.case: Loses on clarity: components, not letters, are the subject.
options.kept: Grid visibility as a real, togglable state.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: One custody line folds through an object's life, gaps and claims shown.
options.viewport: A ribbon-led single column of dated folds.
options.risk: A single object's life cannot index 118 components.
options.case: Holds audience for timelines only; loses on page clarity.
options.kept: Known, awaiting and stale passages drawn differently on every timeline.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Cloth courses step under one fixed window; faults stop mid-step.
options.viewport: A roll of courses under a fixed window.
options.risk: Its overshoot motion breaks the constitution's no-bounce rule.
options.kept: A stalled state is visibly stopped, never animated as if moving.

options.label: Civic Bureau Prospectus
options.thesis: Bone-white plates with one rendered silk ribbon.
options.viewport: Ribbon owns the right bleed beside a large hero.
options.risk: Gradient ribbon and violet are banned or foreign to the brand.
options.kept: Two weights of one face carry the argument.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Letters condense into words and break into weather.
